claimed_coverage: Tests verify that SE_SKIP_CERTS_VERIFICATION handling code in ibmse.rs is unconditionally compiled (not guarded by #[cfg(debug_assertions)]), ensuring the environment variable works in both debug and release builds.
fix_patch_grounding: The fix.patch removes the #[cfg(debug_assertions)] and #[cfg(not(debug_assertions))] guards, replacing them with a single unconditional block that reads SE_SKIP_CERTS_VERIFICATION and conditionally skips certificate verification; tests verify this structural change in the source code.
issue_context_used: The issue describes implementing a runtime-configurable certificate verification skip via SE_SKIP_CERTS_VERIFICATION that works in production/release builds, which directly informed the test cases for verifying the unconditional code structure.
notes: Hidden tests created under /artifacts/evaluation/tests/ verify the source code structure of ibmse.rs. The tests check that: (1) DEFAULT_SE_SKIP_CERTS_VERIFICATION constant is not inside #[cfg(debug_assertions)] block, (2) no #[cfg(not(debug_assertions))] block exists for certificate verification, (3) CertVerifier::new is always inside 'if !skip_certs' block, and (4) the overall fix pattern matches the expected unconditional structure. Tests read from /workspace/deps/verifier/src/se/ibmse.rs and do not mutate the source tree.
